summary: Record Matt's 2026-09-10 invariant decisions and harden the documentation gate. Decisions: (a) backup and restore orchestration is the explicit Controller-owned exception to the no-jobs rule, added to the closed list in AGENTS.md and reconciled into Phase 6 and the Replaceable Controller section of the platform plan; (b) pool and host IDs and the pool name are generated by Nex Core and adopted unchanged, noted in both plans that said the Controller creates them; (c) the Controller operations table mirrors host journal results. Gate: state is required on every record including merged ones (grandfathering removed), a none owner must omit record (an empty string fails), and a controller owner must name one of the closed exceptions. All 73 records without state were backfilled, 13 empty record fields removed, and the host-console-and-vm-media record now names the host-side journal instead of a Controller table. The Controller guide states what its database is authoritative for and cross-links the appliance recovery export. API impact: none; contributor rules, plans, the checker and its tests only.

guide.reason: The Controller setup page now says which data its SQLite database is authoritative for, that pool/host/VM state is re-adopted from hosts, and points the lost-state troubleshooting entry at the appliance recovery export instead of contradicting it.

api.reason: No Controller/Core contract changes; the enrollment identity contract for decision (b) is documented by the code slice implementing it.

state.reason: Contributor rules, plan text, the gate script and change records; nothing is persisted at runtime.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_check_docs.py (21 tests, including the new controller-owner and empty-record cases); python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree and --all against the backfilled records; the guide link check is part of both. Guide text change reviewed against the existing appliance export walkthrough evidence; no new workflow was introduced.
